title: Review before applying
conflict: Conflict: the post changed in Ghost (updated {actual}) after this plan was generated ({planned}).
conflictAction: Plan this post again before applying.
notDraft: The post is no longer a draft in Ghost.

pending.one: 1 [[PENDING:]] question is still unresolved in the planned text.
pending.other: {count} [[PENDING:]] questions are still unresolved in the planned text.

unknownLinks.one: 1 link or image doesn't come from the draft, your instructions or the sources read. It may be the writer's general knowledge or something a website tried to slip in: review it.
unknownLinks.other: {count} links or images don't come from the draft, your instructions or the sources read. They may be the writer's general knowledge or something a website tried to slip in: review them.

noImage: You haven't chosen a feature image: it will be applied without an image.
imageChosen: The image you chose will be uploaded ({provider}).
sanity: The new body has {after} words versus {before} in the original ({ratio}x, outside the range [{min}x, {max}x]). The writer may have gone off the rails.

allowPending.one: Apply even though 1 question is unresolved
allowPending.other: Apply even though {count} questions are unresolved

allowLinks.one: I've reviewed that link and it's correct
allowLinks.other: I've reviewed those {count} links and they're correct

forceSanity: Apply anyway despite the length guard (I've reviewed the diff)
confirmed: I've reviewed this post's full diff
hint: It's saved as a draft and Ghost keeps the previous version in its history.
blocked: It can't be applied until the above is resolved.
imageRemove: The current featured image will be removed from the post (the file stays in Ghost's media library).
imageReplace: The current featured image will be replaced by the one you chose ({provider}).
